decisions.reason: The KiCad 9 variable correction changes how third-party libraries are referenced, but it does not change which 3D model files must be bundled or their destination folder.
The source decision concerns KiCad library-reference syntax, not component availability, alternatives, pricing, or assembly sourceability.
The required integrated-board revision, BOM, and component-position deliverables remain unchanged by the KiCad third-party variable policy.
The source decision does not alter the power-board BOM content, component clarifications, or required manufacturing exports.
The sensor-board BOM, Gerber, drill, and pick-and-place requirements are unaffected by the KiCad 9 library-variable correction.
Connector labels, QR codes, and remaining board markings do not depend on the third-party library-reference variable.
The requirement to review every component's assembly orientation remains valid without modification.
The KiCad library-reference policy has no effect on the requirement for lead-free assembly.
The source decision does not change the main-board production-package requirement or its recorded missing-component observations.
Manufacturing-account access, cart setup, and Basic-parts review remain unchanged; mention of the JLCPCB plugin is incidental.
The AXP2101 electrical topology and thermal-pad requirements are unrelated to the corrected KiCad third-party library variable.
The main-board dimensions, connector configuration, ESP32 placement, and connector orientation remain unchanged; prior mention of KiCad is only descriptive.
